synthesis: DEV-2593 reports Scout users cannot be re-added after deletion because email stays registered. Root cause: User model uses SoftDeletes (User.php:101) + users.email has DB-level unique constraint (migration line 14) + Laravel's unique() validation does NOT exclude soft-deleted rows by default. When admin deletes Scout user via UsersResource (soft-delete), email remains blocked. The resend_onboarding action EXISTS (added by the earlier resend-onboarding hotfix, lines 356-412 ScoutUsersResource.php) but only helps unverified users who still have the permission — it doesn't solve the deleted-user-email-reuse problem. Ticket's 'disable/delete/re-add' workaround fails at re-add because unique validation (ScoutUsersResource:140, UsersResource:58-65) checks ALL users including trashed. Second issue: AC2 'invalidate prior token' is NOT implemented — both old and new signed URLs remain valid until 7-day expiry. ScoutSetPasswordController guards reuse after password-set via email_verified_at, but pre-password multiple valid links coexist.

scope.summary: Fix unique email validation to exclude soft-deleted users in both resources. Enhance error messaging when collision is with trashed user (suggest restore path). Clarify resend-invalidation requirement (AC2). Add test coverage for soft-delete + email reuse. Document restore flow for deleted Scout users.

proposed_changes.change: Replace unique() validation on new_user_email (line 140) with Illuminate\Validation\Rule::unique('users', 'email')->whereNull('deleted_at')->ignore(null). Add custom validation closure to detect trashed-user collision and return actionable error: 'This email belongs to a deleted user ({name}). Restore them in Users, then re-enable Scout access here.'
proposed_changes.reason: Current unique(ignoreRecord: false) includes soft-deleted users. Must exclude trashed rows so email can be reused. Enhanced error guides admin through proper restore flow instead of bare rejection.

proposed_changes.change: Update existing_user_email custom validation (lines 154-170) to exclude trashed: User::where('email', \$value)->whereNull('deleted_at')->when(\$assignedUserId, …). Same enhanced error for trashed collision.
proposed_changes.reason: Covers attach-existing-user path. Current validation checks all users; must exclude deleted.

proposed_changes.change: Replace unique() on email (line 58-65) with Rule::unique('users', 'email')->whereNull('deleted_at')->ignoreRecord(true). Update validationMessages to include trashed-user guidance.
proposed_changes.reason: Same root cause affects general Users resource. Soft-deleted user's email must be reusable. ignoreRecord:true already correct (edit mode), just need whereNull.

proposed_changes.change: CONDITIONAL (if AC2 strict interpretation required): Add users.onboarding_nonce column (nullable string, default null). Include in signed route params. Increment on resend. Validate in ValidateScoutSignedUrl. OR document that overlapping-valid-links is acceptable.
proposed_changes.reason: AC2 'invalidates the prior one' is not implemented. Current: both URLs valid until 7-day expiry. ScoutSetPasswordController guards post-password reuse (email_verified_at), but pre-password multiple links coexist. Versioning adds complexity; overlapping-valid-links may be acceptable tradeoff. Escalate for product decision.

proposed_changes.change: CONDITIONAL (if nonce implemented): Add nonce validation after signature check. Reject if user.onboarding_nonce != request('nonce'). Return 'This link has been replaced by a newer one' instead of generic invalid signature.

acceptance_criteria.item: Clarity → Scout Users provides a 'Resend invite' action for any user who has not yet set a password
acceptance_criteria.reason: resend_onboarding action exists at ScoutUsersResource.php:356-412 (added by the earlier resend-onboarding hotfix per precedents.json). Visible when user has clarity-scout permission AND email_verified_at IS NULL (line 365-375). Sends fresh ScoutOnboardingNotification (line 389), logs activity (lines 403-411), shows success notification (lines 391-394). Test coverage at ScoutUsersResourceTest.php:528-551. Reporter may not have seen it due to visibility conditions, or issue predates that hotfix merge (~48 days ago).

acceptance_criteria.item: Resending issues a fresh invite token and invalidates the prior one
acceptance_criteria.reason: Current implementation generates new temporarySignedRoute (ScoutOnboardingNotification.php:28-33, 7-day TTL) but does NOT invalidate prior URL. Both old and new signed URLs remain cryptographically valid until their respective expiry. ScoutSetPasswordController guards reuse AFTER password-set via email_verified_at check (line 71-73), so once user sets password, ALL links (old and new) become 'used'. But BEFORE password-set, user who never clicked first link can use either URL. If strict single-use-per-resend is required, needs versioning/nonce (add users.onboarding_nonce column, include in signed params, validate in ValidateScoutSignedUrl, increment on resend). Trade-off: adds complexity (migration, validation logic, error messaging) vs current behavior which is secure post-password and only allows overlap pre-password. ESCALATE: is overlapping-valid-links-until-first-use acceptable, or must prior link be cryptographically invalidated immediately on resend?

acceptance_criteria.item: Deleting a Scout user releases their email address for reuse, OR the UI explains that the user already exists and offers 'Resend invite' / 'Re-enable' instead of a bare rejection
acceptance_criteria.reason: CRITICAL BUG. unique() validation on users.email does NOT exclude soft-deleted rows. User model uses SoftDeletes (User.php:101), users table has unique constraint on email (migration line 14), but Laravel's unique() rule checks ALL rows including deleted_at IS NOT NULL. When admin deletes Scout user via UsersResource DeleteAction (soft-delete, UsersResource.php:215-218, labeled 'Disable User' at EditUsers.php:31), user row remains with email + deleted_at set, blocking reuse. Attempting to create new Scout user with that email fails with 'This email address is already in use.' (ScoutUsersResource.php:142) — no mention of trashed user or restore path. Must fix: (1) add whereNull('deleted_at') to unique validation at ScoutUsersResource.php:140 and UsersResource.php:58-65, and ScoutUsersResource.php:154-170 custom validation; (2) enhance error message to detect trashed collision (User::where('email', \$email)->onlyTrashed()->first()) and suggest 'This email belongs to a deleted user ({{name}}). Restore them in Users → re-enable Scout access here.'

acceptance_criteria.item: Re-enabling a disabled user restores their prior access without requiring deletion
acceptance_criteria.reason: Disable = revoke clarity-scout permission via toggle_web_access action (ScoutUsersResource.php:414-488, line 446). Re-enable = grant permission again (line 459), sends onboarding email if unverified (lines 462-464). User is NOT deleted; kit assignment is NOT cleared on disable. If admin used UsersResource soft-delete (different from disable), restore via RestoreAction (UsersResource.php:220-224), then re-enable Scout access via toggle_web_access or EditScoutUser form. Disable/re-enable flow works correctly; the confusion arises from two removal paths (disable vs soft-delete) and the email-reuse bug on soft-delete. Test coverage: ScoutUsersResourceTest.php:316-341 (revoking then granting), 509-524 (toggle sends email to unverified), 572-588 (toggle does NOT email verified).

acceptance_criteria.item: The already-registered error message names the existing user and the available action
acceptance_criteria.reason: Current error: 'This email address is already in use.' (ScoutUsersResource.php:142, UsersResource.php:64, ScoutUsersResource.php:167 custom validation). Does NOT name the existing user or suggest actions. Must enhance to detect collision type and provide guidance: (a) trashed user → 'This email belongs to a deleted user ({{name}}). Restore them in Users, then re-enable Scout access.'; (b) active unverified Scout user → 'This email is already assigned to {{name}} (pending). Use Resend invite if needed.'; (c) active verified user → 'This email is already assigned to {{name}}.' Use User::where('email', \$value)->first() (or withTrashed()->first() to check trashed), inspect deleted_at, email_verified_at, hasPermissionTo('clarity-scout') to determine message.

questions.q: Is AC2 'invalidates the prior one' a hard requirement requiring cryptographic invalidation (versioning/nonce), or is overlapping-valid-links acceptable given that (a) both links expire after 7 days, (b) post-password-set all links are guarded by email_verified_at, (c) only pre-password overlap allows dual-valid links?

What is the intended Scout user removal flow: (1) disable only (revoke clarity-scout permission via toggle_web_access, user remains active), or (2) soft-delete allowed (UsersResource DeleteAction, user.deleted_at set)? If soft-delete is valid, email MUST be released (fix unique validation). If disable-only is intended, document that Scout users should NOT be soft-deleted, only disabled.
Does 'delete' in the ticket refer to soft-delete (UsersResource DeleteAction, sets deleted_at) or disable (ScoutUsersResource toggle_web_access, revokes clarity-scout permission)?
questions.answer: Almost certainly soft-delete. ScoutUsersResource.canDelete() returns false (line 502-505), so no delete action is exposed there. UsersResource HAS DeleteAction (line 215-218, soft-delete). Reporter's 'disable/delete/re-add' sequence suggests they used UsersResource delete (sets deleted_at), which leaves email blocked. The 're-add' attempt then hits unique constraint. If they had only used toggle_web_access (disable), email would not be blocked, but they couldn't 'delete' from Scout Users resource (action doesn't exist).

questions.q: Should resend_onboarding action be visible for users who have expired link but haven't set password (email_verified_at still NULL)?
questions.answer: YES, already the case. Action is visible when user.email_verified_at IS NULL AND user.hasPermissionTo('clarity-scout') (ScoutUsersResource.php:365-375). Expired link is just a signature-check failure; email_verified_at remains NULL, so resend action stays visible. This is correct behavior — user with expired link needs resend.

User model SoftDeletes trait at line 101. Migration 0001_01_01_000000_create_users_table.php line 14: \$table->string('email')->unique()->nullable(). DB-level unique constraint does NOT exclude deleted_at. Laravel unique() validation rule also does NOT exclude soft-deleted rows by default — must explicitly add whereNull('deleted_at') or withoutTrashed() scope.

ScoutUsersResource models Kit (line 37: protected static ?string \$model = Kit::class), not User directly. The form creates/attaches User via EditScoutUser page (ScoutUsersResource/Pages/EditScoutUser.php:54-156 mutateFormDataBeforeSave). This is why delete action is disabled — deleting Kit is not the intent; deleting/disabling User is.

UsersResource query uses withoutGlobalScope(SoftDeletingScope::class) at line 228, so trashed users ARE visible in admin list (with red background, line 230). RestoreAction is available (line 220-224). This is the proper restore path for deleted Scout user, but it's two-step: restore in Users, then re-enable Scout access in Scout Users. Not intuitive; better error messaging helps.

ScoutSetPasswordController guards link reuse via email_verified_at check (not by invalidating URL). Once password is set (email_verified_at marked, line 118-121 in controller), guardUser method (lines 66-84) aborts with 'already used' error. But BEFORE password-set, multiple active URLs can coexist (overlapping resends). After password-set, ALL URLs (old and new) are 'used'.

The invite-link invalid-signature fix (precedents.json, Done ~16 days ago) fixed 'Invalid signature on Scout invite link' — relevant to AC2 if we implement nonce-based invalidation, as it shows signature validation is already a known pain point.

Filament unique() rule uses Illuminate\Validation\Rule under the hood. To exclude soft-deleted rows, replace ->unique(table, column, ignoreRecord) with Rule::unique(table, column)->whereNull('deleted_at')->ignore(recordIdOrNull).

grounding.code_flow: Admin creates Scout user (ScoutUsersResource EditScoutUser) → toggle create_new_user:true OR select existing user → mutateFormDataBeforeSave validates email (line 140 or 154-170) → BLOCKS if collision with trashed user (BUG) → if passes, User.create or User::find → KitSettings.updateOrCreate (1:1 kit↔user, lines 127-139) → givePermissionTo('clarity-scout') (line 75 or 112) → ScoutOnboardingNotification sent if unverified (line 76 or 115) → User clicks signed URL (7-day TTL) → ValidateScoutSignedUrl middleware validates → ScoutSetPasswordController.show (guardUser aborts if email_verified_at set) → user submits password → ScoutSetPasswordController.update sets password + email_verified_at (lines 118-121) → link becomes 'used' for all future attempts (guardUser check). Resend: admin clicks resend_onboarding (line 356) → new ScoutOnboardingNotification (line 389) → new signed URL (old URL NOT invalidated, both valid until expiry). Delete: admin uses UsersResource DeleteAction → User soft-deleted (deleted_at set) → email STILL blocks reuse (unique constraint includes trashed).

sites.reason: ->unique(table: 'users', column: 'email', ignoreRecord: false) does NOT exclude soft-deleted rows. Must replace with Rule::unique('users', 'email')->whereNull('deleted_at')->ignore(null) to allow email reuse after soft-delete.

User::where('email', \$value)->when(\$assignedUserId, …)->exists() does NOT exclude trashed. Must add ->whereNull('deleted_at') before ->exists() check. Also needs enhanced error for trashed collision (suggest restore).

->unique(table: 'users', column: 'email', ignoreRecord: true) does NOT exclude soft-deleted rows. Must replace with Rule::unique('users', 'email')->whereNull('deleted_at')->ignoreRecord(true). ignoreRecord:true is correct for edit mode (excludes current record), just need whereNull for trashed.

Generates 7-day signed URL with user.id param. Does NOT invalidate prior URLs (no versioning/nonce). AC2 'invalidates the prior one' is not implemented. This is a design choice, not a bug per se. ScoutSetPasswordController guards post-password reuse (email_verified_at), so security is maintained after first use. Pre-password, multiple valid links can coexist (overlapping resends). ESCALATE: is this acceptable, or must prior link be cryptographically invalidated immediately on resend?

Correctly guards against link reuse AFTER password-set via email_verified_at check (line 71-73). If email_verified_at is set, aborts with 'This invitation link has already been used.' Secure. Does NOT prevent multiple valid links BEFORE password-set (overlapping resends until first use). Consistent with current design; versioning would change this.

Action exists, works correctly, sends fresh ScoutOnboardingNotification, logs activity, shows success notification. Visibility rules (unverified + has clarity-scout) are appropriate. Test coverage exists (ScoutUsersResourceTest.php:528-551). Issue is NOT that action is missing (AC1 satisfied), but that (1) email reuse is blocked by unique constraint on trashed users (AC3 broken), and (2) prior token is not invalidated (AC2 not implemented). Resend action alone doesn't solve the ticket's core problem.

Toggle action grants/revokes clarity-scout permission (lines 446, 459), sends onboarding email if unverified (lines 462-464), handles roleless users (lines 455-457). Correct implementation of disable/re-enable flow (AC4 satisfied). Does NOT soft-delete user; email is NOT blocked on disable. Confusion arises from two removal paths (disable vs soft-delete).

Returns false, disabling delete action in this resource. Scout users are not deleted via Scout Users resource; they are disabled (toggle_web_access) or soft-deleted via general UsersResource. This is intentional design (Kit-modeled resource doesn't delete Kits). Not a bug, but contributes to confusion about proper removal flow.

Soft-delete and restore actions work correctly. UsersResource query uses withoutGlobalScope(SoftDeletingScope::class) at line 228, so trashed users are visible (red background, line 230). RestoreAction is available for trashed users. This is the proper path for restoring a deleted Scout user, followed by re-enabling Scout access in ScoutUsersResource. Works as designed; just needs better documentation and error messaging to guide admins.

DB-level unique constraint on email is correct (prevents duplicate emails in active users). Constraint does NOT exclude deleted_at, which is standard for DB constraints. The bug is in Laravel validation layer (must exclude trashed in unique() rule), not in DB schema. No migration needed; fix is validation logic only.

pg_tables: users — email column: no schema change (DB-level unique constraint stays). Fix is validation logic (add whereNull('deleted_at') to unique checks). If AC2 versioning implemented: ADD onboarding_nonce column (nullable string, default null) via migration.
data_impact.mv_or_cdc_implications: None. User management, invite sending, email validation are pure PostgreSQL transactional. No ClickHouse, materialized views, or CDC involved.

Validation is O(1) DB lookup. No iterative queries, no batch operations, no scale-sensitive paths. If AC2 versioning implemented, onboarding_nonce increment is single-row UPDATE on users table (trivial).

Create 3 users: Alice (alice@example.com, Kit A, clarity-scout, unverified email_verified_at NULL), Bob (bob@example.com, Kit B, clarity-scout, verified email_verified_at set), Charlie (charlie@example.com, no Kit, no clarity-scout). Soft-delete Alice via UsersResource. Now: Alice row exists with deleted_at set, email alice@example.com blocked. Attempt to create Carol (carol's real email is alice@example.com) on Kit A → hits unique constraint bug. Restore Alice → re-enable Scout on Kit A → resend onboarding → verify email sent with fresh URL.
personas: Admin user (ADMIN role, Scout-enabled org, can access both Users and Scout Users resources)
Unverified Scout user (clarity-scout permission, email_verified_at NULL, has kit assignment, pending onboarding)
Verified Scout user (clarity-scout permission, email_verified_at set, has kit assignment, active)
Soft-deleted Scout user (deleted_at set, email still in users table, clarity-scout permission persists on trashed row, not visible in Scout Users but visible in Users with trashed filter)
Disabled Scout user (clarity-scout permission revoked via toggle_web_access, deleted_at NULL, still active user, no longer appears in Scout-filtered views)

escalate.reason: Two critical ambiguities require product/design decision before implementation can be scoped: (1) AC2 'invalidates the prior one' — is strict cryptographic prior-token invalidation required (needs users.onboarding_nonce column, versioning in signed URL, validation in middleware, error messaging for 'replaced by newer link'), or is overlapping-valid-links-until-first-use acceptable (simpler, current behavior is secure post-password-set via email_verified_at guard, only pre-password overlap allows dual-valid links)? Versioning adds migration, validation logic, and UX complexity; overlapping-valid-links is simpler and arguably secure enough given 7-day expiry + email_verified_at guard. (2) Intended Scout user removal flow — should admins soft-delete Scout users via UsersResource (in which case email MUST be released by fixing unique validation, and two-step restore flow must be documented), or should Scout users only be disabled via toggle_web_access (in which case document disable-only policy and warn against UsersResource soft-delete for Scout users, but still fix unique validation to prevent accidental lockout)? Without these clarifications, implementation may solve the wrong problem or miss the intended UX. Recommend product/PM review of both questions, then proceed with clear requirements.
